episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Despite his daughter's desperate plea to stay, Alfred and his friend Sigbjørn set out on an 18-month assignment on a merchant ship headed to New York.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As vessels sink and allies perish, Alfred and Sigbjørn brave the German navy's imminent threat as their involuntary participation in the war drags on.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In the wake of the war, Sigbjørn attempts to rebuild his life in Norway until a shocking letter leads him to make a fateful decision.
